source.boundary: A DP is a discardable secondary replacement in a repairable mother. The removed DP does not enter item repair. ItemReorder is placed at a DEPOT station.

predeclared_native_acceptance: All 23 populated source tables preserve columns and rows in the native import/export roundtrip. Five guarded steps finish with exit zero, the converter has zero errors and only the expected ENLOG warning #108, and report and event log are nonempty.
The aircraft's critical failure leads to the accepted LRU exchange. On arrival, the removed LRU identifies the nested failed DP and receives the local DP spare in an ItemReplacement SURP task.
The removed DP physical individual is explicitly discarded at the base after removal; no DP direct-repair task or return to stock occurs.

The base DP demand is replenished from depot stock; a depot reorder of one DP starts and arrives after the configured one-hour lead. The transported DP arrives at base after the configured two-hour transport. Reconcile physical individual identities and stock levels through the event log.

The 72 half-hour report bins show one system failure, one system repair, one fulfilled demand, no backorder, and a ready/available aircraft at the 36-hour terminal state. Mission outcome and raw evidence hashes reconcile.
A separate read-only reviewer replays the frozen contract against raw events, ledgers, report, invocation, closure and source hashes without importing the author validator.
limits: Only one seed, one DP beneath one LRU, one base and one depot, stock-based reorder size one, and a 36-hour horizon are accepted.
